description: We're Jan Burda, Lucie Vávrová and Ladislav Vávra, three students at Charles University in Prague. We love a good challenge and are curious about space, remote sensing and Earth observation. We're fascinated by what satellite data can tell us about our planet and the impact it can have. We created POLAR CHANGE to make these data easier to explore. We'd love to meet people interested in coding, geography, climate science or bringing fresh ideas.
